components.name: Primary Solid Glass Button
components.description: Edge-lit Ember amber key for primary hold actions and confirmations.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 13px; border-radius: 7px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.28); background: var(--accent, #f59e0b); color: var(--accent-ink, #1a1002); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.36), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.24), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.36); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, transform 110ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #fbbf24); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0.5px) scale(0.985); } .ds-label { line-height: 1; text-box-trim: trim-both; text-box-edge: cap alphabetic; }

components.name: Quiet Solid Glass Button
components.description: Tactile smoked/porcelain glass key for manual durations and secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 13px; border-radius: 7px; border: 1px solid var(--glass-edge-strong, rgba(255,255,255,0.155)); background: var(--glass-control, rgba(41,47,59,0.92)); color: var(--ink, #f5f7fa); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-control-rim, rgba(255,255,255,0.16)), inset 0 -1px 0 var(--glass-under, rgba(0,0,0,0.34)), 0 1px 2px var(--glass-contact, rgba(0,0,0,0.36)); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: var(--glass-control-hover, rgba(54,62,77,0.96)); }

components.name: Solid Glass Pane
components.description: Edge-lit framed container for Manual hold, Dashboard readout, and Settings groups.
components.css: .ds-glass-pane { background: var(--glass-panel, rgba(26,30,38,0.84)); border: 1px solid var(--glass-edge, rgba(255,255,255,0.095)); border-radius: 10px; padding: 15px 18px; color: var(--ink, #f5f7fa); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-rim, rgba(255,255,255,0.125)), 0 1px 2px var(--glass-contact, rgba(0,0,0,0.36)), 0 12px 28px -16px var(--glass-shade, rgba(0,0,0,0.64)); }

components.name: Sliding Segmented Control
components.description: Milled recessed track with raised Solid Glass thumb and cap-centered labels.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--well, #090b0f); border: 1px solid var(--well-border, rgba(255,255,255,0.075)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px var(--well-shade, rgba(0,0,0,0.56)), inset 0 -1px 0 var(--well-rim, rgba(255,255,255,0.08)); } .ds-seg-active, .ds-seg-item { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 13px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; text-box-trim: trim-both; text-box-edge: cap alphabetic; } .ds-seg-active { border-radius: 6px; background: var(--glass-control, rgba(41,47,59,0.92)); border: 1px solid var(--glass-edge-strong, rgba(255,255,255,0.155)); color: var(--ink, #f5f7fa); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-control-rim, rgba(255,255,255,0.16)), 0 1px 2px var(--glass-contact, rgba(0,0,0,0.36)); } .ds-seg-item { color: var(--ink-muted, #8b95a8); }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Pill
components.description: Active navigation item resting inside the outer chrome rail.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 35px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--glass-control, rgba(41,47,59,0.92)); border: 1px solid var(--glass-edge, rgba(255,255,255,0.095)); color: var(--ink, #f5f7fa); font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-control-rim, rgba(255,255,255,0.16)), 0 1px 2px var(--glass-contact, rgba(0,0,0,0.36)); }

narrative.overview: Ember is a tactile, edge-lit desktop instrument built for Windows developers running coding agents. It bridges flat utility clarity and Solid Glass materiality: thick, near-opaque smoked dark panes and luminous porcelain light panes that read as solid from afar and reveal delicate top specular rims, crisp hairlines, and grounded contact shadows up close.
keyCharacteristics: Clear 3-tier tonal contrast: outer shell, inset workspace sheet, and edge-lit Solid Glass panes.
Finish lives strictly at the edge (top specular rim + hairline + grounded shadow); faces stay flat and readable.
Recessed grooves for switch and segmented tracks contrast physically with raised floating glass thumbs.
Optical cap-height centering across every button and sliding segmented control via CSS text-box-trim.

rules.name: The Edge-Only Finish Rule
rules.body: Glass materiality is expressed through a 1px top specular highlight, a crisp outer hairline, and a grounded contact shadow—never surface gradients or muddy transparency over text.

rules.name: The Amber Restraint Rule
rules.body: Ember amber signals active awake state, enabled policies, and primary CTAs only; chrome stays strictly neutral, and violet/lavender is never introduced.

dos: Do preserve strong tonal separation between outer chrome (--chrome), wrapped workspace sheet (--canvas), and Solid Glass panes (--glass-panel) in both themes.
Do center all button and segmented labels with .control-label cap-height trimming so text never sits low inside controls.
Do keep Manual hold and the 4-metric Dashboard readout framed in distinct .glass-pane rectangles while keeping Automatic policies open on the canvas for visual rhythm.
donts: Don't nest bordered cards inside other bordered cards; use hairline dividers inside a single .glass-pane.
Don't use hyper-transparent liquid glass blur or color gradients across readable text faces.
Don't introduce violet or lavender tones into Ember's own palette, or strip concise helper descriptions from Settings rows.
